title: DC-area forecast: Spotty light showers gradually arriving. Soaking rain and breezy tonight into Sunday.
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: Spotty light showers are possible late this afternoon into early evening, especially south and west of DC, as temperatures slip from near 70 into the 60s. Soaking rain develops area-wide around or after midnight.

What’s next? Breezy and wet Sunday as the remnants of Isaias continue to bring soaking morning rain, afternoon showers, and maybe a few evening thunderstorms. Sunshine gradually returns Monday, with dry weather into midweek.

Forecast in detail

Tonight: Clouds thicken and humidity increases as the remnants of Isaias approach. The chance of spotty light showers increases during the evening, especially south and west of DC. Steadier, more widespread rain holds off until around or after midnight. Lows in the upper 50s to low 60s. Confidence: Medium

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Sunday): Soaking morning rain could transition to intermittent showers by late morning or early afternoon. A few thunderstorms could develop toward evening with a risk of damaging wind gusts and a brief weak tornado, especially southeast of DC. Humid highs in the mid-60s to near 70, with winds from the east around 15 to 20 mph and gusts of 25 to 30 mph. Confidence: Medium

Storm rain totals look to average about 1 to 1.5 inches, though amounts could range from about 1 inch to 3 inches.

Tomorrow night: Showers and perhaps a thunderstorm continue into the overnight. Rains should become more intermittent but we could see one last wave around sunrise. Humid lows in the upper 50s to low 60s. Confidence: Medium

A look ahead

A mix of sun and clouds returns Monday, after a possible lingering shower early as Isaias moves farther away. It stays muggy, with highs in the upper 60s to low 70s. Winds from the northeast around 15 to 20 mph could gust to 25 mph. Confidence: Medium

Sunny skies and warmer temperatures return Tuesday as highs climb into the mid-70s to near 80. Humidity eases a bit, but it remains somewhat muggy, with dew points in the 60s. Confidence: Medium

Skies remain mostly sunny Wednesday, with highs in the upper 60s to low 70s. The next chance of showers arrives in the evening. Confidence: Medium

Today’s daily digit — 6/10: More clouds than we'd like, but at least the rain holds off for daytime outdoor plans before showers move in tonight. | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.

DC weather history for October 10

A rare October 1979 snowstorm brought the earliest measurable snowfall on record, disrupting travel and knocking out power with heavy, wet flakes.
